item.title: Communities fight ICE detention centers, but have few tools to stop them
item.description: ICE is undertaking a massive expansion fueled in large part by the record $45 billion approved for immigration detention by Congress.

item.title: CT libraries face possible 20% cut to cross-town borrowing program
item.description: Library advocates are asking state legislators to fully fund borrowIT CT after Gov. Ned Lamont proposed a 20% cut to the program's budget.

item.title: PODCAST: In CT, curling is more than an Olympic sport
item.description: WSHU's Ebong Udoma and CT Mirror's Dave Altimari discussed his article about the Norfolk Curling club, which is celebrating its 70th anniversary amid the Winter Olympics.

item.title: As CT renters rally for eviction reform, lawmakers make a change
item.description: A CT bill on no-fault evictions has gotten nowhere in the House in past sessions. So this year, the Senate will be up first.

item.title: After Bethany case, bill would make camp staff mandated reporters
item.description: The bill was discussed the same day the Office of the Child Advocate issued a report recommending all camp workers get background checks.

item.title: CT restaurant association rebrands as voice of hospitality industry
item.description: The Connecticut Restaurant Association is rebranding itself as an advocate for the broader $21 billion hospitality industry.

item.title: To recruit first responders, CT weighs tuition, mortgage assistance
item.description: Under Lamont's bill, CT would waive tuition at public colleges and universities and offer mortgage assistance for police and firefighters.

item.title: Don’t widen CT’s lanes. Use tolls and trains
item.description: There are only two proven methods to ease highway congestion: you either disincentivize automobile transportation or you incentivize its alternatives, and ideally you do both.

item.title: Growing up under the algorithm
item.description: Social media isn’t just connecting teens, it’s consuming them, and we need a better policy approach to curb harm.

item.title: CT needs a moratorium on lithium ion batteries for utility scale storage
item.description: Legislation being considered would put a moratorium on using lithium ion batteries for BESS (battery energy storage systems). It’s a very good idea.
